name: Psi-DOM
summary: ψ-DOM, or psi-DOM, also known as 2,6-dimethoxy-4-methylamphetamine or as Z-7, is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and Ψ-PEA families related to DOM. It is a positional isomer of DOM in which the methoxy group at the 5 position has been relocated to the 6 position. The drug is taken orally.

pharmacology.text: ψ-DOM shows affinity for the serotonin 5-HT2A and 5-HT2C receptors (Ki = 49–351 nM and 50 nM, respectively). Its affinity for the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor was about 2.6- to 3.5-fold lower than that of DOM. The drug acts as an agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor similarly to DOM.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Psychedelics of this kind can cause nausea, anxiety, confusion, raised heart rate and blood pressure, and frightening experiences, and can trigger lasting mental health problems in vulnerable people.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。這類迷幻藥可能引起噁心、焦慮、混亂、心跳和血壓上升以及驚恐的經驗，也可能在較脆弱的人身上誘發持久的精神健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。这类迷幻药可能引起恶心、焦虑、混乱、心跳和血压上升以及惊恐的经验，也可能在较脆弱的人身上诱发持久的精神健康问题。

fact.en: The psi in its name marks the 2,4,6 arrangement of groups on its benzene ring, instead of the 2,4,5 arrangement in DOM. It is also known by the code Z-7.
fact.zh: 名稱中的 psi（Ψ）表示苯環上的基團呈 2,4,6 排列，而不是 DOM 的 2,4,5 排列。它也以代號 Z-7 為人所知。
fact.zhHans: 名称中的 psi（Ψ）表示苯环上的基团呈 2,4,6 排列，而不是 DOM 的 2,4,5 排列。它也以代号 Z-7 为人所知。
